data.gender_notes: AlIrfan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘irfā’, meaning ‘to know’, ‘to gain knowledge’, or ‘to be aware’. In Islamic context, AlIrfan represents spiritual knowledge and wisdom. The name AlIrfan carries the meaning “Knowledgeable, Wise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlIrfan usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledgeable, wise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolic of knowledge and wisdom granted by Allah.
data.etymology: AlIrfan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Knowledgeable, Wise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlIrfan total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name AlIrfan carries a deep cultural significance for Muslims, who believe in the pursuit of knowledge and the continuous learning and understanding of various aspects of life. The name not only highlights the importance of acquiring traditional forms of knowledge such as science, mathematics, linguistics, and history, but also emphasizes the importance of gaining knowledge of the divine through the study of religious texts and practicing the Five Pillars of Islam. Through the name AlIrfan, Muslims are encouraged to broaden their horizons and to strive for knowledge and understanding, both in material and spiritual matters.
data.spiritual_significance: AlIrfan holds great spiritual significance for Muslims, as it represents the journey towards a deeper understanding and connection with the divine. It is believed that seeking knowledge and wisdom is essential for drawing closer to Allah and gaining a greater understanding of the world and the purposes of creation. As the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "The seeking of knowledge is an obligation upon every Muslim." (Bukhari and Muslim). Through the name AlIrfan, Muslims are reminded of the importance of seeking knowledge and wisdom as a means to draw closer to Allah and to live a more spiritually fulfilling life.
